title: Principal bundles in supersymmetry
summary: We discuss rather basic problems on super principal bundles for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds (over $\mathbb{R}$) and analytic supermanifolds over a complete field of arbitrary characteristic. Sharper answers are obtained for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds and for homogeneous supermanifolds. Among others, it is proved for $C^{\infty}$-supermanifolds that given a $C^{\infty}$-supermanifold $B$ and a super Lie group $G$, there is a natural one-to-one correspondence (up to isomorphism) between the $G$-super principal bundles over $B$ and the $G_{\mathrm{rd}}$-principal bundles over…
